VERDICT: LGTM

The new `getMembershipNumber()` slots in exactly alongside the two existing derived, `@Transient` getters (`getDisplayName()`, `getInitials()`):

- Same unit: a derived read-only property on `Owner`, which is where the sibling derived values already live — no new class or catch-all forming.
- Same idiom: `@Transient`, one-line expression over existing fields, placed right after the other two derived getters and before `getPetsInternal()`.
- Javadoc matches the established house style ("Not persisted — derived from {@link ...} and {@link ...}") and cross-links the contributing getters.
- The OpenAPI entry mirrors the adjacent `customerCode` property (title/description/type/example/`readOnly: true`), placed logically next to it.

No duplication and nothing is becoming a grab-bag. A maintainer of this file would find it natural.
